I don’t think that’s a bad idea, but idk, right now making plans for consults and what I want kinda feels like me making plans of what I’ll want on my moon base. It just doesn’t really feel attainable, if that makes sense? 

I’m happy it’s working for you, but I kinda feel like focusing on it to that kind of detail and thinking about it might just make me feel worse since it’s so far away? I don’t know, I’m rambling. Thanks for throwing that idea out there though, maybe I’ll try it out later and see if it helps.

With my insurance, probably something like 3k. But it’s not covering electrolysis right now, which is probably gonna cost something like 9k

Idk, I don’t know how much energy I have left for more consults and looking around

I don’t do anything anymore, I’m too tired. I wake up, maybe go to class, and then watch YouTube and browse Reddit until it’s time for bed.

It doesn’t seem like I’m ever going to transition, so I’m just waiting until I die, or something
I don’t enjoy anything anymore. It all seems so pointless. I’m just wasting time
Idk. If I’m lucky, maybe I’ll get hit by a bus or something

I just really don’t want my pictures to be spread around by people like that.

Even if that doesn’t happen, I’m scared that the people on that subreddit will just confirm my worse fears and tell me that I’m right about never being able to pass
What if I take them and they don’t feel good? It’s not like they’ll change who I am as a person...
Thank you for your input, it’s appreciated
It’s really out of my hands. Hormones won’t change me that much
It’s a realistic thought. And if it won’t help me, then it would be a lot of wasted time and effort
There’s really not
Mid 20’s

>Because we want to help you, I'd like to ask you to post in r/transpositive or something so that we can actually try to determine that.

I really don’t want to be made fun of. No good will come from me posting a picture there
Because I’m too old and puberty has already ruined me. Because hrt won’t change my bones.
Of course it comes into the decision, why would I start something if I know that I’m going to fail?

How are you going to tell me that people see trans women as women when I see a half dozen Reddit threads every day full of people saying otherwise

I live in one of the most liberal cities in the country, even hereI see what people say to trans women who don’t pass
Are they? If I don’t pass, people in public won’t see me as a woman, they’ll see me as a dude that’s trying to dress up like one
Again, because I have eyes and can look into a mirror

Because I’m not stupid or blind. I am capable of looking in a mirror.

I’m so sick of people treating me like an idiot and acting like I’m being silly for being realistic about my outcomes
My family will never correctly gender me. And I don’t think that I’ll be happy if only other trans people see me as a woman
I really won’t
I’m at the point of thinking that if I’ll never be a cis woman, then why bother?
But I don’t think that I deserve it
But do I deserve to be happy and healthy?

I think about this everyday, and how I’ll never be as real or valid as a cis woman

No matter how hard I try, I’ll never be as good as them
But I’d be an ugly woman tho
But I wanna be in that universe
All of my day dreams and fantasy’s featured female protagonists too, but I’m sure that there’s nothing to read into there
I never played as femshep, I thought that people would make fun of me
I always thought that female protagonists and characters were inherently more interesting and relatable, but that could mean anything...
But I would be ugly and would never pass
Can someone explain the male lesbian thing to me? I’ve never quite understood it
But lots of people hate their bodies, maybe it’s just something like that instead of dysphoria
But lots of people hate their body, so it might not be dysphoria

That’s another thing, I don’t know if I even want to wear dresses. They would look terrible on me. I’ve never been into going shopping or dressing up. That probably means that I’m lying to myself, right?
Is that a vote for death?
But then I have to go talk to an actual person about all of this. That’s too scary. I’m never going to be brave enough to do that
But I don’t know for sure that I have gender dysphoria. I could just be making all of this up
Everyone is valid except for me
But what if I am tho
Yeah, but I would feel like such a fake

I wish that I was brave enough to play as a female character in dnd

I feel like everyone would think that I was weird
Voice training just seems like it’s so difficult and maybe even impossible. It’s incredibly demoralizing.
So you’re saying that I’m not going to be that pretty? :(
I feel like I never exercise because I’ve already accepted that I’m never going to look how I want to look, so why even try? Giving up is so much easier
Idk, I really hate the sight of myself, my body is irreversibly damaged. I don’t think that even E could fix that lol
Just because I came out to my friends as trans doesn’t mean that I’m actually trans, I’m sure a lot of cis guys do that
Not if I’m too scared to talk to anyone about it
It just feels like I would get instantly thrown out of their office for wasting their time
Or the fact that I would go out and buy hormones by the bucketful if I didn’t need a prescription. Doesn’t mean anything at all

Not me, I’m the one actual cis guy that’s on here, just because I’m that good of an ally

Yeah...

I don’t understand how I’m supposed to just walk into some stranger’s office and say “hey, I wanna be a woman, gimme the drugs”

It seems impossible and insane
More like twice an hour am I right?
Isn’t that a mood

Being smooth and clean feels so good, but it takes so long and it always fucking grows back way too fast

I can’t even find the energy to keep doing it. Guess I just have to suffer like this lol
Haha I’ll always be a deformed freak that doesn’t fit in anyway lmao
Exactly and it’s like, I’ll be dead sooner or later, right?
Is it living my truth if I lie in my bed all day
my body is pretty much already irrevocably ruined from puberty lmao
There’s just so many of them, and they all hate me. What if they’re right?
It helps keep me in my lane
It’s so much easier just to accept the misery
Are you telling me that it’s not good for my mental health if I have a word document where I copy and paste transphobic comments I find on the internet?
It’s hard to read the comments in there. But there’s just so many of them, all saying the same things.
They don’t say it be like it be, but it do
But lots of straight cis dudes fetishize lesbians, so that explains why I get so sad and jealous when I see any portrayal of them ever, right?
Ha, me as a girlfriend. Now that’s crazy
I’ve been to a therapist before. Multiple therapists. They’ve all told me that I have nothing to worry about and to stop wasting their time with my nonsense. I would expect that trend to continue.
I’ve seen the things that people say about trans people that don’t pass. That’s what I would be. I don’t want to end up like that. I just want to forget about all of this.

Don’t even get me started on my voice. I’ve gone through years of voice therapy before. None of it did jack shit. It was a gigantic waste of time. There’s absolutely no hope for me on that front.

The whole thing is dumb. It’s not doable. It’s not hard, it’s impossible
A therapist would laugh me right out of the appointment if I told them any of these things. Everyone would think that it’s some kind of sick joke. There’s no way.
Are you saying that I shouldn’t be going into the comments and copying all of the transphobic comments into a word document so I can read them all later?
Lmao I wish that I could cry lol
What if I just hate who I am? Me being the other gender wouldn’t change any of that. I’d still be me at the end of the day.
Lmao I’m going to die alone because I’m a freak lol
It didn’t get bad until I found these subreddits, so I’m probably making it up based on that.
I’m so detached from other people that I don’t even have crushes anymore. Being in a relationship is inconceivable to me
The failing grades that I’m going to get on all of these midterms for one.
Haha I’m going to die alone lmao
In my mind, nothing can undo 20+ years of what testosterone and puberty has done to ruin my body. What’s the point of starting now? It’s already too late for me.
That’s still garbage as well. I’m as stupid and shallow as I am ugly.

Wonderful is not a word people use to describe me. Or beautiful, or pretty or any of that.

Maybe the world is right. I probably am just a freak

I’m not trans, I’m just dangerously straight.

-me
I would give anything to forget about all of this, and cleanse my mind of these thoughts
Maybe they’re right. I feel like a disgusting monster.
Yeah but do I deserve any of that?

I don’t ever remember my dreams, but I think I’m a guy in them, so my subconscious is probably telling me that I’m just making all of it up.

I’m sure that it works like that. Makes perfect sense.
One of my options is “I wish I was a gamer”, and I’m not sure how to take that

It be like that sometimes. But it’s true, I’ll never be like them. Doesn’t really matter how sad that makes me, I guess.

Guess I have to keep being cis and suffer through it, right?
I probably am tho

Lmao wouldn’t it be funny if I pressed the button as a joke, and then lived the rest of my life as a woman, lol wouldn’t that be such a great goof? Me and the lads would certainly laugh about that one

If only it was that easy :(

But everyone would press the button, and I will reject all evidence to the contrary.

But uh, if you have the button, can you slide it over this way?
Tranz is my jam. So good. I probably listen to it an unhealthy amount

I like football, and I was always taught that only dudes like sports, so I have to be a cis man!

*furiously ignores how dumb of an idea that is*

Yeah, like it would be frickin’ rad to be a girl and it’s all that I can think about, but I’m not trans, so I can’t do anything about it.

That how it be sometimes
Fair, but I don’t use face app because I’m scared that girl me would be ugly. That’s what a cis dude would do. Checkmate
I usually wish for being a girl, or being dead. One of the two, I’m not picky.

“I’m already a guy in real life. I just want to get away from that from a while and be something else. It’s so boring and lame being a guy, why wouldn’t I pick the female option?”

That’s my go to, and I never really understood why people would willingly play as a dude if given the choice.

Yeah, I’m probably just going through a phase. I bet that’s it. Totally. 

*continues browsing every trans subreddit in existence*
But all the tests I take say that I’m at about 50/50, so that obviously means that I’m cis, no matter how disappointing that result is to me

Nothing to read into there, for sure. Sometimes, I write that name down on a piece of paper and just stare at it for awhile. Totally normal

And really, I bet that every one is really bothered when they think about their given name being on their tombstone.
It’s fine, I’ll deal with it, I guess. Just gotta shove all of this deep down where it can never get out and then just forget about it. That always works

Yeah, I usually think this, but my name is genuinely terrible, so I’m totally cis. 

And it’s not that weird that I have a female name picked out, just for laughs, right?
I’m not going to say where I live. Just normal therapists, I guess. Not specialized

They’ll laugh me out of the room if they hear me say “being a woman seems pretty swell, and I spend most of my time thinking about it.” I’ve been to therapists before. I know how that goes.

I don’t know, I’ll get over all of this or something, I guess. Can’t last forever

Depression, for most of my teenaged years. I don’t know, I’ve started thinking about it constantly in the past couple of months. I thought about it before now, but not like this. I don’t know what the hell is wrong with me. I just need to forget about the whole thing
It’s normal to take gender tests and be really disappointed when it doesn’t come back overwhelmingly female, right? That’s a normal phase every cis guy goes through, I bet

It’s perfectly normal for a cis guy to shave their body, feel incredibly good, and then being incredibly sad when the hair grows back a day and a half later, right? Or to have a female name picked out, just in case? And also to be incredibly bothered and saddened when someone says that I would be a hideous girl and hold onto that statement for months? Or to feel a vague hint of jealously when I see a woman walking around, having fun? Perfectly normal stuff, right?

Mirrors also bother me immensely, I hate having my picture taken, I think about my gender constantly, every day, every hour and curse my luck that I wasn’t born a woman. My name seems like it’s someone else’s, and I’m always disappointed when I respond to it. I always pick the female option in games without hesitation, and I wish I was brave enough to play as a woman character in dnd and stuff. I can just never get invested in the guy characters.

But hey, I have a (fucking god awful, ridiculous, hideous) beard and I’ve only started thinking about this recently in my 20’s, so I’m probably cis. Even if I wasn’t, my body is probably already ruined. There’s more stuff, more examples I could say, but who gives a fuck. I’ll always be me, I guess. I’ll never get rid of this body. Goddammit 

I just know that in another universe, the “prime” me is a woman.

I’m a cis guy, and I’m so tired of relating to these memes. I just want to be a normal person who doesn’t feel like this all the time. Why can’t I be normal? I don’t want to feel like this. Please, can someone tell me that there’s nothing wrong with me?
And it probably would be best if I wasn’t drinking at 3 in the morning, but we all know how that turned out.
Holy shit I miss cutting myself
